name: GD RL Env
description: Exposes Geometry Dash as a gym-style RL environment over TCP.

rl-enabled.name: RL mode
rl-enabled.description: Freeze the game and step it only on commands from the trainer. Set BEFORE entering a level.

port.name: TCP port
port.description: Localhost port the trainer connects to.

dt-scale.name: Tick dt scale
dt-scale.description: Multiplier on the 1/240 s per-tick dt. Tweak only if the dummy client shows skipped/doubled ticks.
